text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A baby was among 18 villagers slaughtered by Moslem guerrillas in Douaouda village, near Algiers.
- The killing of 18 villagers in Douaouda demolishes Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia's claim that the government has crushed the guerrillas.
- Gunmen kill four real estate employees in Ain Benian district in the north of Algiers.
- University teachers to suspend strike over pay on Monday.
- The Transitional National Council debates the government's performance in implementing its programme in 1996.
- Algerian businessmen meet Tunisian counterparts on cooperation.
